svg.title: Marking operations and the travel between their endpoints
svg.desc: A readable redraw of the supplied research schematic. Gray and white shapes retain its visual context. Fourteen numbered red marking segments follow the supplied arrangement, rather than placing one arbitrary stroke inside each drawn part. Dashed navy connectors run from the origin to the first entry, between each exit and the next entry, and back to the origin. Coordinates and the manually selected route are illustrative, not an industrial dataset or a reported optimizer result. Contours are not collision constraints.
